turns.text: what if I require only one WASA for the all modules?

must_contain: a single WASA certificate can cover multiple or all modules
every module the certificate is meant to cover must already be built before you apply
you cannot certify a module that has not been developed yet
notes: variant b of faq-verbatim-sandbox-general-03, the same question in the non-native phrasing a developer might use in a hurry
